MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Control of Radio Communications.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the. Japanese Government, AG 676.3 (14 Jul 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1744, 14 July 1947 subject: Control of Radio Communications, as amended.
2. Inclosures 1 and 2 of this memorandum are the bimonthly lists of amendments including all additions, deletions and changes to Inclosures 1 and 2 of SCAPIN 1744/29, prepared and submitted in accordance with paragraphs 12 and 13 of reference 1.
3. This memorandum confirms all amendments authorized by direct communication between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and the Radio Regulatory Commission during the months of January and February 1951.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K. B. BUSH
